intro.title: Professional interpreting, wherever your meeting happens
paras: BeTranslated provides interpreters for virtual meetings on Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet. Your audience hears you in their own language, in real time.
Our global network includes specialists in rare languages who may not be available locally.
checks: No travel, accommodation or venue costs
Interpreters who specialise in your industry
Clear, real-time delivery on the platform you already use

quote.title: Request an interpreter
quote.lead: Tell us about your event and we reply with a free, no-obligation quote.
quote.checkTitle: What to include in your request
checks: Date, start and finish times, and your time zone.
The platform you will use, such as Zoom, Teams or Google Meet.
The type of interpreting: consecutive, simultaneous or telephone.
The number of attendees and the subject of the meeting.
quote.note: With these details we can reply with availability and a quote as quickly as possible.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Which platforms do you work with?
We interpret on Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet.
Tell us your platform and we confirm the set-up.
RSI delivers each language on its own audio channel, so participants listen in real time.
It suits conferences and larger multilingual meetings.
Our global network gives access to specialists who may not be available locally.
Do you provide sign language interpreters?
Yes, for healthcare and other settings where deaf and hard-of-hearing participants need access.
Tell us the requirements and we confirm availability.
Can I combine remote and on-site attendees?
Yes. Hybrid meetings blend on-site and remote participation.
We advise on the best set-up for your event.
How do I get a quote?
Complete the form on this page with your languages, date and platform.
We reply with a free, no-obligation quote.
